change: Use the exact mean position intercept for each joint’s unchanged secant velocity

proposed_by.agent: Codex (Trajectory Tracking Agent chord integral lane)

name: P5.s.pass3.chord-integral
summary: Set the board position to the least-squares intercept for its existing secant velocity.
description: Integrate the stock piecewise-linear, endpoint-held target position over the compensated host interval. Subtract the mean travel of the existing secant from that mean position. The tape, timing, velocity, midpoint feedforward, and gains stay identical to the parent.
expect: Dev tool_track_rms_mm < 0.03100 mm, versus 0.031333594888818476 mm for p5s-pass3, with all five gates passing on all 42 dev tasks. An analytic intercept removes the mean reference error of each fixed-slope hold.
